datasets.title: FloralTraits v1.0: colour, pattern, symmetry and shape traits of 787 flowering-plant species from 192,127 citizen-science photographs
SettlementAffinity v1.0: settlement affinity of 698,550 plant and animal species and species richness of urban settlements
A global two-sided dataset of plant–flower visitor interactions and partner-family dependence
A global dataset of terrestrial animal dependence on single host, food-plant and prey families
A global dataset of 222 million biodiversity photo observations in GBIF by species, grid cell and country

r_packages.name: pollmap
r_packages.title: Spatial Modelling of Pollination Supply, Demand and Species Distributions
r_packages.note: Maps wild-bee pollination supply in farmland with the Lonsdorf, InVEST and quality-weighted edge models in one raster framework, links species distribution models to service maps and matches supply to crop pollination demand.

r_packages.name: spinet
r_packages.title: Spatial Interaction Networks Under Environmental Change
r_packages.note: Projects ecological interaction networks through space and time from species distribution model output, with network metrics, interaction beta-diversity, rewiring and coextinction robustness.

r_packages.name: InsectTrack
r_packages.title: Detection, Tracking and Activity Mapping of Insects in Videos
r_packages.note: Detects and tracks insects in videos with YOLO, open-vocabulary or background-subtraction detectors and turns their trajectories into counts, activity time series, heat maps, flower visits and nest traffic, with standard tracking-accuracy metrics.

r_packages.name: InsectTrait
r_packages.title: Colour, Pattern and Shape Traits of Insects from Photographs
r_packages.note: Extracts 67 colour, pattern and shape traits of insects from field photographs or GBIF and iNaturalist observations, with photo screening, colour and exposure checks and trait reliability tests.

r_packages.name: FlowerTrait
r_packages.title: Colour, Pattern, Symmetry and Shape Traits of Flowers from Photographs
r_packages.note: Extracts flower colour, pattern, symmetry and shape traits from field photographs or GBIF and iNaturalist observations, with photo quality screening and trait reliability checks.

r_packages.name: svid
r_packages.title: Systematic Spectral Index Discovery, Deduplication and Validation
r_packages.note: Generates candidate spectral indices from multispectral or hyperspectral bands, removes duplicate formulations and ranks the rest under spatially aware validation with confidence intervals and reference baselines.

r_packages.name: cloudscape
r_packages.title: Clear-Observation Availability and Cloud Analysis for Optical Satellite Image Time Series
r_packages.note: Turns Landsat and Sentinel-2 cloud statistics into measures of whether an optical time-series study is feasible at a location, including the effect of cloud loss on phenology retrieval.

r_packages.name: surfscape
r_packages.title: Composition and Configuration in Continuous Landscape Surfaces
r_packages.note: Tests whether continuous landscape metrics on vegetation indices respond to composition or configuration, simulates continuous neutral landscapes and decomposes metric change between dates.

r_packages.name: darkniche
r_packages.title: Climatic Dark Diversity and Directional Niche Coverage
r_packages.note: Finds species that are absent from a region despite tolerating its climate, using directional niche-coverage metrics, analytical null models and validation against introduced ranges, with results for all 619 terrestrial ecoregions.

r_packages.name: settlementaffinity
r_packages.title: Species Settlement-Affinity Index from Occurrence Data
r_packages.note: Computes how strongly species favour or avoid human settlements from occurrence records, with robust standard errors, and classifies species as avoiders, exploiters, tolerant or uncertain.
